description: This PHP source file defines the KpiSummaryModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance API Model namespace. The class implements serialization and normalization features for representing KPI summaries derived from ReviewerRating entities, including properties for id, title, minRating, and maxRating.

classes.name: KpiSummaryModel
classes.description: A model representing a KPI summary, serializable for API responses. It encapsulates KPI attributes like id, title, minimum rating, and maximum rating, based on a ReviewerRating entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the KpiSummaryModel with a ReviewerRating entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization and normalization.
